lines.t: Before the dawn, before the stars took flame,
He wrote each life, He called each name.
No heart unseen, no spark misplaced,
Each soul is breathed with love embraced.
A whisper forms within the dark,
The smallest light, a holy spark.
The Hand unseen begins to weave,
And life awakens, hearts believe.
For LIFE IS, before its very conception,
A thought of love, a perfect reflection.
Blessed be the name of The One who commands,
Every child formed gently by His hands.
He paints their eyes with skies of peace,
Their hearts with songs that never cease.
Each breath a promise, each cry a sign,
That heaven’s mercy is by design.
He gathers souls before they are born,
Shelters them safe through trial and storm.
No child forgotten, no tear in vain,
Their lives inscribed in His refrain.
For LIFE IS, before its very conception,
A thought of love, a perfect reflection.
Blessed be the name of The One who commands,
Every child formed gently by His hands.
From nothing to breath, from silence to sound,
His love is the womb where all life is found.
Blessed be the One, both now and forever,
The Giver of Life, forsaking never.
